Member B - Catarina Antonio

I implemented the campus graph using an adjacency list to represent buildings and their
connections. I also developed functions to load and validate building and connection
data, display the graph, and calculate building degrees and total connections. Did BFS
using a queue and visited structure to display reachable buildings and their distances.
Lastly, I created graph tests for connected, isolated, and unknown buildings.


Member C - Daniela Cortez

I implemented the department tree using a tree structure to represent the university's
departments and their parent-child relationships. I also developed functions to load and organize
department data, display the tree, and perform preorder, postorder, and level-order traversals.
Additionally, I created functions to count the total number of departments, identify leaf departments,
and calculate the height of the tree.


Member A - Lucy Naggayi

I implemented the facilities records: loading valid facility records, searching by ID using the custom ID hash table,
searching by facility name, searching by category and displaying them. I also created a custom hash table class keyed by facility ID, 
supporting insertion, lookup, duplicate-key detection, and collision handling and creatin a category report.
